import io, json, os, re, contextlib, importlib, time
def norm(s): return re.sub(r'"createdAt": \d+', '"createdAt": T', s) if isinstance(s,str) else s
def run(mod, store):
    os.environ["ITEMS_STORE"] = store
    cmds = [["create","a"],["create","b"],["create","c"],["list"],["list","--page","2","--page-size","2"],
            ["list","--page","1","--page-size","2"],["list","--page","0"],["list","--page-size","0"],
            ["get","2"],["get","9"],["bogus"],["create"],["list","--page","x"],["list","--page","-1"]]
    out = []
    for argv in cmds:
        buf = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
            try: rc = mod.main(argv)
            except SystemExit as e: rc = ("exit", e.code)
        out.append((rc, norm(buf.getvalue())))
    mod._ITEMS = []
    a = mod.create_item("x"); b = mod.create_item("y")
    out.append(norm(json.dumps(mod.list_items(1,1)))); out.append(norm(json.dumps(mod.list_items(2,1))))
    out.append(norm(json.dumps(mod.list_items(3,5)))); out.append(norm(json.dumps(mod.get_item("2")))); out.append(str(mod.get_item("zz")))
    out.append((a["id"], b["id"], sorted(a)))
    return out
res = {}
for name in ["old_items","new_items"]:
    mod = importlib.import_module(name)
    store = f"{os.getcwd()}/{name}.json"
    if os.path.exists(store): os.unlink(store)
    res[name] = run(mod, store)
    print(name, "store after:", open(store).read()[:80] if os.path.exists(store) else None)
print("identical" if res["old_items"] == res["new_items"] else "MISMATCH")
EOF
